podcast.title: Sid Vicious's Membership – Early Band
podcast.body: Sid Vicious was part of a group called Flowers of Romance, one of his early musical projects before he joined the Sex Pistols. "And he was also part of a group called Flowers of Romance."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Sid Vicious's Tenure
podcast.body: Sid Vicious was briefly a member of Flowers of Romance, but the band "didn't amount to anything." "Eventually, he found his way into a band called Flowers of Romance, but that didn't amount to anything."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Introducing "Uncharted": Sid Vicious and Questions About the Murder of Nancy Spungen

podcast.title: Siouxsie Sioux's Early Band
podcast.body: Formed by Susan Ballion (who became Siouxsie Sioux) after being inspired by the Sex Pistols, this punk band featured future Sex Pistols member Sid Vicious on drums. "forming a band called Flowers of Romance, which featured future sex pistols, Sid Vicious on drums."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.body: Sid was also part of a group called Flowers of Romance, another one of his early band projects in the burgeoning punk scene. "And he was also part of a group called Flowers of Romance."
